source: NOAA HAFS-A and HAFS-B operational GRIB2 parent or storm grid
licence: NOAA US government output; unrestricted use, attribution requested, no implied endorsement. https://registry.opendata.aws/noaa-nws-hafs/

field_inventory.number_concentrations: not published in the inspected product; no retrieved number moments are claimed
field_inventory.soil: not published; four soil layers from same-cycle GDAS f000 through the pinned existing donor mapping
field_inventory.terrain: native HAFS terrain at each valid time; moving grids must be decoded independently
field_inventory.snow_and_ice: Not published; same-cycle GDAS physical analysis through the declared donor mapping.
field_inventory.sea_surface_temperature: HAFS skin temperature, which equals the water boundary temperature over sea; land values are not ocean state.
field_inventory.vertical_velocity: HAFS geometric vertical velocity (discipline 0 category 2 parameter 9), m/s
field_inventory.mean_sea_level_pressure: NCEP MSLET local-table selector, discipline 0 category 3 parameter 192, level type 101.

geometry: GDT 0 regular latitude-longitude with earth-relative winds. Some publications pad a rotated valid footprint with missing values. largest_common_finite_rectangle retains the largest complete rectangle shared by all selected fields. Every time owns its grid; moving objects must be independently decoded.
input_identity: input manifests bind dynamic paths and content digests; receipts identify primary and soil donor separately
